~Abo1Z~ Atx1 is the copper chaperone for 
copper amine oxidase  and 
Golgi/plasma membrane monovalent copper transporting ATPase
possibly others

so its upstream involved in "protein maturation" rather than directly in,  for example, amine catabolism, or copper export
